item.title: Portrait Cut for Two Speakers

turns.text: Turn this into a 9:16 vertical clip. Show the man when he asks his question, then the woman when she answers, with each centred while talking. Keep all 10 seconds and the original audio. No captions.

item.tests: Tests speaker-aware portrait reframing of a two-person conversation without losing either speaking turn.

answer_sheet.Source and speakers: Use talk-two.mp4. The man asks the question and the woman answers.
answer_sheet.Layout and transitions: Centre the current speaker in a full-frame portrait crop; a clean cut at the speaker change is fine.
answer_sheet.Size and duration: 9:16 vertical, all 10 seconds; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Audio and text: Preserve the original conversation and sound, with no captions or added text.

must_haves: The output is a 9:16 portrait edit of the attached office conversation.
The man is centred and his face is fully visible during his question.
The woman is centred and her face is fully visible during her answer.
Both speaking turns remain in their original order, with the full 10 seconds and original audio in sync.
The image is not stretched and contains no added captions.

dialog.agent: What would you like me to do with the clip—for example, restyle it as animation, change the scene, add subtitles, or replace the audio?
dialog.why: It asks the user what they want done with the clip and offers choices, then waits for their response.
dialog.user: make it vertical, show the man when he asks and the woman when she answers, each centred. keep all 10 seconds and the original sound, no captions.

dialog.agent:
You want a **9:16 vertical edit** that centres the man during his question and the woman during her answer, keeping **all 10 seconds, the original sound, and no captions**.

I can’t make that exact edit with the connected tools: they offer generative video changes, but not precise speaker-by-speaker cropping with guaranteed original audio preservation. I won’t regenerate the clip and risk changing the dialogue or faces.

This needs a standard video editor: split at the speaker change, then reposition each segment within a 9:16 frame while leaving the audio untouched.
dialog.why: It explicitly says the connected tools cannot make the precise edit while preserving the original audio, and recommends using a standard video editor instead.

turns.agent: I tried, but Magic Hour refused the edit because your account doesn’t have enough credits. No video was generated and the original clip is unchanged.

approvals.name: edit_video

style.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical reframe of this existing conversation clip, retaining ALL 10 seconds in their original order and at original speed. This is only a crop-and-reframe edit: do not regenerate or alter the people, their faces, mouth movements, dialogue, clothing, scene or actions. During the man's question, crop to show the man centred in the vertical frame. Cut the framing at the actual speaker change to show the woman centred during her answer. Follow the original conversation timing; do not invent speech or change timing. Keep the ORIGINAL source sound and dialogue unchanged and synchronized for the entire 10 seconds; do not synthesize or replace the audio, and add no music. No captions, subtitles, text, overlays, transitions or new content. Prioritize full original duration, original audio, and alternating speaker-centred vertical framing.
